about:
Hello BEAUTIFUL!! My name is L’oréal. I’m a Licensed Full Specialist Esthetician that specializes in Lash Extensions. Thank you for choosing me as your Lash Artist!! 

!!BEFORE BOOKING PLEASE READ POLICY!!

- Be mindful of availability when booking, the assignment is VERY TEDIOUS and I will not rush my craft! 
-Come to your lash appointment with a clean canvas (LASHES FREE OF ANY MASCARA)
-I do not fill over other Lash artists work. If you currently have Lashes on you will need to book a removal and full set of your choice
-Remember you appointment starts at booking time. THE CLOCK IS TICKING! After 15 minutes without communication your appointment will be canceled and cancellation fee will be processed. MY TIME IS IMPORTANT JUST AS WELL AS YOURS. IF YOU SEE THAT YOU’RE  RUNNING BEHIND GIVE ME A CALL IM MORE THAN WILLING TO WORK WITH YOU! 
-Wear comfortable clothes to your liking. You may bring a throw blanket if you are cold natured. Salon temperatures can be slightly cool. 
- Payments can be make via cash or processed with card on file. 
- There is a $25 fee for after hour and same day squeeze in appointments. Please contact me for availability. 
-NO EXTRA GUEST 
- NO REFUNDS. If you are not satisfied with your set after 24 hours I will do a FREE removal. 
-Any issues with retention will receive a FREE set that can only be issued during the same week of original appointment 
- All sets require a $20 non refundable deposit that will go toward your service. 
- If you cancel your appointment for any reason a new deposit will be required when booking again! 
- Lash class deposits are a higher fee and also non refundable considering this is a full day session 
- Sunday Lash Appointments are an additional
 +$30 

PLAN ACCORDINGLY!!! 

By booking with Loaded Lashes you agree to the policy stated above! Hope to see you soon 🖤
